name: Sample: the phases of mitosis
notes:
The phases of mitosis (how one cell splits into two identical cells), in order: P-M-A-T, then cytokinesis.
Prophase: the chromosomes condense into thick X shapes and the nuclear envelope breaks down.
Metaphase: the chromosomes line up single file across the middle of the cell (the metaphase plate).
Anaphase: spindle fibers pull the sister chromatids apart, toward opposite ends of the cell.
Telophase: two new nuclear envelopes form, one around each set of chromosomes.
Cytokinesis: the cytoplasm pinches in two, leaving two separate, identical daughter cells.

stops.label: foosball table
stops.fact: Mitosis is the process where one cell splits into two identical cells.
stops.scene: You see a massive Toe-sis (toe) jump onto the foosball table, snapping into two identical twins mid-air.
stops.imagePrompt: A giant anthropomorphic toe standing on a wooden foosball table, splitting into two exact mirror images of itself, vibrant studio lighting, cartoon style.

stops.label: putting green
stops.fact: The phases of mitosis in order are prophase, metaphase, anaphase, telophase, and cytokinesis.
stops.scene: On the putting green, you watch a Pro-fase (a pro golfer) hit a Met-a-fase (medal) ball, which trips an Ana-fase (ant) into a Tel-a-fase (telephoto lens), triggering a huge Cytokinesis splash.
stops.hook: prophase → pro-fase, metaphase → met-a-fase, anaphase → ana-fase, telophase → tel-a-fase, cytokinesis → cytokinesis (science juice)
stops.imagePrompt: A professional golfer hits a gold medal ball that bumps a giant ant into a massive telephoto camera lens, causing a splash of blue liquid, bright sunny golf course.

stops.label: equipment rental kiosk
stops.fact: In prophase, chromosomes condense into thick X shapes and the nuclear envelope breaks down.
stops.scene: At the kiosk, a Pro-fase golfer squeezes X-shaped chrome-o-somes, causing the nuclear envelope to shatter like glass.
stops.imagePrompt: A professional golfer at a rental kiosk holding glowing X-shaped chrome objects, shattering a transparent glass envelope, high contrast, clean lines.

stops.label: chess set
stops.fact: In metaphase, chromosomes line up single file across the metaphase plate in the middle of the cell.
stops.scene: You see the chess pieces magically line up single file across the middle of the board on a giant invisible Met-a-fase plate.
stops.imagePrompt: Chess pieces marching in a single straight line across the center of a giant stone chess board, glowing white plate underneath, cinematic lighting.

stops.label: wall art
stops.fact: In anaphase, spindle fibers pull sister chromatids toward opposite ends of the cell.
stops.scene: On the wall art, an Ana-fase ant uses tiny spindle fibers like fishing rods to drag sister chromatids toward opposite corners of the frame.
stops.hook: anaphase → ana-fase, spindle fibers → spindle fishing lines, sister chromatids → twin sisters
stops.imagePrompt: A giant ant on a framed painting using fishing poles to pull two twin girls in opposite directions, vibrant wall art background, playful art style.

stops.label: tv screen
stops.fact: In telophase, two new nuclear envelopes form around each set of chromosomes.
stops.scene: You smack the TV screen, watching a glowing 'telephone' phase through the glass as two fluffy 'envelopes' seal shut around a bundle of colorful yarn chromosomes.
stops.imagePrompt: A person reaches out to touch a large television screen. Inside the screen, a colorful toy telephone sits while two glowing paper envelopes flap shut around tangled strands of yarn, bright cinematic lighting.

stops.label: recycling bins
stops.fact: In cytokinesis, the cytoplasm pinches in two to create two separate identical daughter cells.
stops.scene: You push the recycling bins together, watching a 'sigh-to-kinesis' cyclist squeeze the bin's plastic 'cyto-plasm' paste until it pops into two identical doll-sized 'daughter cells'.
stops.hook: cytokinesis → cyclist/sigh-to-kinesis, cytoplasm → cyto-plasm, daughter cells → daughter cells
stops.imagePrompt: A person stands between two recycling bins. A tiny cartoon cyclist is squeezing a glob of blue modeling clay that splits into two small identical doll figures, natural bright daylight.
